channels.title: Channels
channels.emptyHelp: Channels matching this filter appear here. Connect a peer and open a channel, or load more results.
channels.partial: Only loaded channels are filtered and sorted. More channels are available; load more to include them.
channels.replayWarning: This BLAKE2b channel lacks unified signatures. Its commitment transactions may be replayable on the other chain.
channels.actionUnavailable: This action is unavailable with the current credential or chain status. Check the node information and credential scopes.
channels.noPolicy: This channel has no forwarding policy to display yet.
channels.policyReadOnly: Policy details are read-only in this release. Fee-policy editing comes in a later release.
channels.fromLink: Opened from a link: check the details. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
channels.invalidAmount: Enter a whole number of satoshis.
channels.pushHelp: Optional. Funds given to the peer when the channel opens; whole satoshis.
channels.feeHelp: Optional. Leave empty for the node estimate; use a decimal point, at most three decimals.
channels.noLimits: Spending limits must be configured first.
channels.destinationHelp: Optional for cooperative close. Leave empty to use the channel's closing address, normally this node's wallet.
channels.externalShutdown: This channel was opened with a closing address that is not known to be this node's wallet. The funds go to that address, so the close counts against the spending limits.
channels.closeFeeUnavailable: Closing fees are deducted from channel funds. The exact fee is not estimated here; a zero budget impact does not mean closing is free.
channels.forceWarning: Force close can cost more and leave funds locked until the channel timelock matures. The exact fee and delay are unavailable. Funds return to this node’s wallet.
channels.closeWarning: Close this channel and return the funds to the previewed destination, after closing fees. This cannot be undone.
channels.duplicateWarning: A similar spend was already recorded. Check the existing outcome before confirming another.
channels.acknowledge: I checked the similar spend and intend this additional operation.
channels.feeOverride: The fee exceeds a configured threshold. Password confirmation is required.
channels.forceStepUp: A force close requires a fresh password confirmation.
channels.stepUpReason: This channel operation needs your password because of the spending limits or fee policy.
channels.cannotClose: This channel is closed or unavailable for closing.
channels.unknownHelp: Do not start another operation. Automatic reconciliation may still settle this spend. Check the same request again and keep its reference.
channels.closePending: Close pending: waiting for the peer
channels.followState: Check the channel state to follow progress. An accepted request does not mean the channel has finished opening or closing.
